Ann Intern Med 2015;163:701-711, as summarized by the ACC ('Ten points to remember', 2015-11-23)
sources.note: Relayed from the FNP case clinic-calf-ache-after-flight-now-breathless, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch with quotes of the ACC summary (the article itself was not read): 'Clinicians should use validated clinical prediction rules to estimate pretest probability'; the Wells rule or the revised Geneva score; with all rule-out criteria negative, probability is under 1% and neither D-dimer nor imaging is ordered; intermediate probability: 'a high-sensitivity D-dimer measurement as the initial diagnostic test'; 'Clinicians should obtain a CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA) in patients with high pretest probability of PE'; 'D-dimer testing should not be obtained in patients with high pretest probability of PE.'
Simplified teaching model written for exam practice; not a validated physiological model. Disease courses, effect sizes and local waits are authored and carry FLAG.
